Measured frequency at Synthetic Osprey Hydro stayed below 59.90 Hz for 9.2 seconds after separation. The Synthetic Osprey Hydro plant ramped 20 MW in 5.2 seconds once the indicated frequency reached 59.82 Hz. The assigned cause at Synthetic Osprey Hydro was a cooling-setpoint mismatch on bank 2 during the heat-wave fixture.
title: Synthetic Osprey Hydro transformer cooling-control failure during a heat wave

reference_summary: A feeder lockout at Synthetic Pinion Substation opened breaker 3A after 1.55 seconds of measured undervoltage. The Synthetic Pinion Substation storage inverter curtailed 12 MW because its ride-through timer expired. Tagging records show bank 3 remained in local mode at Synthetic Pinion Substation, blocking the remote cooling command. The Synthetic Pinion Substation current-transformer ratio used 220:5 while the relay file still assumed 400:5. The Synthetic Pinion Substation plant ramped 25 MW in 5.5 seconds once the indicated frequency reached 59.78 Hz. Synthetic Pinion Substation recorded a 138 kV depression at 14:11:08 during the fictional transformer cooling-control failure during a heat wave. The Synthetic Pinion Substation after-action note requires independent telemetry on the reserve ramp, not the stale RTU channel.
title: Synthetic Pinion Substation transformer cooling-control failure during a heat wave

reference_summary: Customers on the fictional Synthetic Nimbus Bus lateral saw a 11-minute interruption recorded by the meter log. A feeder lockout at Synthetic Nimbus Bus opened breaker 2A after 1.20 seconds of measured undervoltage. A firmware deadband of 0.8 percent kept the Synthetic Nimbus Bus controller from releasing reactive support. A neighboring capacitor bank at Synthetic Nimbus Bus switched in 1.20 seconds later and reduced the voltage lag. The assigned cause at Synthetic Nimbus Bus was a cooling-setpoint mismatch on bank 2 during the heat-wave fixture. A written check at Synthetic Nimbus Bus now requires matching cooling setpoints before peak-shaving dispatch. The sequence log at Synthetic Nimbus Bus marked the initiating trip when residual current reached 420 A.

reference_summary: The Synthetic Cedar Tap current-transformer ratio used 220:5 while the relay file still assumed 400:5. The corrective action at Synthetic Cedar Tap restored remote control of bank 3 and verified the 220:5 ratio. The Synthetic Cedar Tap after-action note requires independent telemetry on the reserve ramp, not the stale RTU channel. Adjacent 138 kV buses at Synthetic Cedar Tap absorbed 29 MW of redirected flow for 14 minutes. The Synthetic Cedar Tap storage inverter curtailed 14 MW because its ride-through timer expired. A feeder lockout at Synthetic Cedar Tap opened breaker 3A after 1.55 seconds of measured undervoltage. Tagging records show bank 3 remained in local mode at Synthetic Cedar Tap, blocking the remote cooling command.

reference_summary: Operators at Synthetic Quartz Bank noted the first alarm 14 minutes after the fictional initiating discontinuity. A feeder lockout at Synthetic Quartz Bank opened breaker 3A after 1.55 seconds of measured undervoltage. The corrective action at Synthetic Quartz Bank restored remote control of bank 3 and verified the 220:5 ratio. Measured frequency at Synthetic Quartz Bank stayed below 59.90 Hz for 9.6 seconds after separation. A neighboring capacitor bank at Synthetic Quartz Bank switched in 1.55 seconds later and reduced the voltage lag. Tagging records show bank 3 remained in local mode at Synthetic Quartz Bank, blocking the remote cooling command. The sequence log at Synthetic Quartz Bank marked the initiating trip when residual current reached 435 A.
